paper_title: Token-Level Uncertainty Estimation for Large Language Model Reasoning
caption: Left: Uncertainty estimations in different token decoding temperature . Right: Influence of token decoding temperature on uncertainty-based AUROC scores.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the influence of token decoding temperature on uncertainty-based AUROC scores, with the x-axis representing "Decoding Temperature" ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 in linear scale, and the y-axis representing the AUROC score ranging from 0.000 to 0.175 in linear scale. Three distinct lines are plotted: the red line with circle markers labeled "AU" starts at approximately 0.125 at a decoding temperature of 0.0, remains relatively flat until 0.4, then rises steeply to approximately 0.178 at 0.8; the blue line with circle markers labeled "TU" begins at approximately 0.125 at 0.0, stays nearly constant until 0.4, then increases to approximately 0.150 at 0.6 and further to approximately 0.178 at 0.8; the green line with circle markers labeled "EU" remains constant at 0.000 across the entire range of decoding temperatures from 0.0 to 0.8.
